व्योम

VYOMA . A King born in the dynasty of bharata, the son of duṣyanta. It is mentioned in bhāgavata, skandha 9, that vyoma was the son of Dāśārha and the father of jīmūta.

व्योमारि

VYOMĀRI . An eternal Viśvadeva (deity concerned with offerings to the Manes). (mahābhārata, Anuśāsana Parva, Chapter 91, Stanza 35).

व्योमासुर

VYOMĀSURA . Son of māyāsura. For the story how kṛṣṇa killed this asura, see under kṛṣṇa, para 24.
